description: StreamCure Analytics Case Study Dataset: Air Beijing and Bike Sharing Data is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Syed Muhammad Akbar Gardezi. "This dataset includes preprocessed case study data used in the evaluation of the StreamCure Analytics toolkit. It contains two publicly available datasets: the Air Quality Beijing dataset and the Bike Sharing dataset. These were used to demonstrate real-time data quality analysis, handling of missing values, and drift detection using StreamCure\u2019s techniques. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
